items.difficulty_reason: The lemma equates multicross singularities with the delta-invariant count and with towers of point-glueings (statement lines 3478-3490). The proof (lines 3492-3530) is complete: the algebraic equivalence is imported, the forward direction runs a descending induction with an explicit completed-ring inclusion computation (branches add, delta adds plus 1), and the reverse direction factors the normalization and kills the squishing alternative by contradiction. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a systematic induction with clean bookkeeping hinges.
